signals.title: mozgsml/memgres
signals.content: Drop-in memory layer for AI agents on a single Postgres. Store documents (not LLM-guessed facts), edit by whole body or unified diff with content-hash optimistic concurrency, organize as an ltree tree, recall lexically or semantically (pgvector) or hybrid, git-blame every line, reconstruct any version, erase for real. Library + HTTP + MCP. MIT.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; large language model relevance. Final score: 68. Freshness: source age 0d.
